cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've limited lunch to the two of us. That disastrous family reunion did us a favor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I've accepted the lesson: no audience to make us compete. You may finish a sentence today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter asked whether we're expecting twelve more. Shall I tell him no?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Two is the approved number. We're applying what we learned; nobody has to storm out before you get a turn.
